highlights: Saved local chat threads with automatic titles, rename, search, continue, and recoverable Trash for chats and recordings.
Editable preferences and instructions for each chat, with newer preferences taking priority and no extra AI calls for memory.
Bounded recent and relevant context targets at most 1.9x estimated fresh text input, capped at 1,800 added tokens; actual provider costs vary.
Conversations reopen after quitting; interrupted answers are preserved for reading and excluded from future inference context.
Pasted prompts preserve code spacing and support Show more, full-message copy, text selection, and native selected-text copy.
